question: what a template variable of the pinned Auth version does, and whether the reauthentication variables exist
source: raw.githubusercontent.com/supabase/auth/v2.196.0/<path>, fetched with curl on this host
template_body_is_fetched_over_http: template.go:459-471 calls the cache, template.go:473-490 issues http.NewRequestWithContext GET under a 10 second timeout and returns template_body_http_error when it fails
conclusion: Twelve template variables and twelve subject variables exist at this tag. No variable sets a templates directory or mounts a volume, and a non empty value is an HTTP URL: an empty one yields the body compiled into the binary, and a value that does not begin with http is prefixed with SiteURL and fetched over HTTP anyway.

The tag lists no reauthentication template or subject variable in example.env while the code declares the field (configuration.go:499) and handles ReauthenticationTemplate (template.go:82, :532-533), so the names are accepted with no upstream example value to copy and the compiled default applies.
Because the runtime network is internal, a template URL would have to be served from inside that network, which is why the design ships no template override.
not_verified: The running pinned image was not exercised for templates; this reading is the tag source only.
Whether an operator served template from inside the runtime network renders end to end was not tested.
